messages.snippet: Helena, Stephen, Confirming we've received the £8m upfront in cleared funds (8 December). Proposing
messages.subject: Larkspur — upfront received; first JSC
messages.plaintextBody:
Helena, Stephen,

Confirming we've received the £8m upfront in cleared funds (8 December). Proposing the first Joint Steering Committee meeting for the week of 5 January, and we'll start the CAL-218 materials transfer (c.38g drug substance) in parallel. Looking forward to working together.

Marisa Caldwell
Calbryn Therapeutics
